inferred.cause: the portal sky is a primary full view drawn before the main view; its first surface sorted after opaque takes the depth-fade snapshot (vk_copy_depth_fade), which RTX resumes in the post-bloom pass (Vulkan resumes the main pass), so the main view begins in RENDER_PASS_POST_BLOOM; vk_begin_{dlight,spot,csm}_shadow_render_pass accepted only RENDER_PASS_MAIN and refused, so the main view had no atlas, no publication and no receivers
inferred.counterReading: u:1 with caster:0 is the main view's uncacheable sun atlas refused at its begin; h:1 and the 4 receivers are the portal sky scene's, from a cached atlas

fix.rule: leave the open scene pass (main or post-bloom), resume the same one, as vk_motion_blur does
